title: Glowing sailing boat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='sky' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#1a1040'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#3a2a7a'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='sea' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#2f7fd0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#14407e'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- sea -->
  <rect x='0' y='68' width='100' height='32' fill='url(#sea)'/>
  <!-- moon glow -->
  <circle cx='78' cy='20' r='9' fill='#fff3b0'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='20' r='13' fill='#fff3b0' opacity='0.25'/>
  <!-- sea sparkle -->
  <path d='M0 76 q10 -5 20 0 t20 0 t20 0 t20 0 t20 0' fill='none' stroke='#8fd0ff' stroke-width='2' opacity='0.8'/>
  <path d='M0 88 q12 -5 24 0 t24 0 t24 0 t28 0' fill='none' stroke='#6fb8f0' stroke-width='2' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- hull -->
  <path d='M22 68 L78 68 L68 80 L32 80 Z' fill='#e0563c'/>
  <path d='M22 68 L78 68 L74 73 L26 73 Z' fill='#f5876e'/>
  <!-- mast -->
  <rect x='48' y='22' width='4' height='46' fill='#f0c060'/>
  <!-- main sail -->
  <path d='M52 24 L52 64 L80 64 Z' fill='#fbe9c8'/>
  <path d='M52 24 L52 64 L66 64 Z' fill='#ffd98a'/>
  <!-- jib sail -->
  <path d='M48 26 L48 64 L26 64 Z' fill='#c9ecff'/>
  <path d='M48 26 L48 64 L37 64 Z' fill='#9fd8f7'/>
  <!-- glow aura on sails -->
  <path d='M52 24 L52 64 L80 64 Z' fill='#fff6d0' opacity='0.25'/>
  <!-- pennant -->
  <path d='M52 22 L66 26 L52 30 Z' fill='#ff7ab0'/>
  <!-- small wake -->
  <path d='M30 80 q6 4 12 0' fill='none' stroke='#b0e0ff' stroke-width='2'/>
  <path d='M58 80 q6 4 12 0' fill='none' stroke='#b0e0ff' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- stars -->
  <circle cx='14' cy='14' r='1.6' fill='#fff6d0'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='9' r='1.3' fill='#fff6d0'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='12' r='1.5' fill='#fff6d0'/>
  <circle cx='90' cy='40' r='1.4' fill='#fff6d0'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='36' r='1.2' fill='#fff6d0'/>
</svg>
